title: Psychedelic Mushroom Sorcerer
description: A young man with dark hair stands at the center of a glowing purple pentagram, wearing a black jacket with 'MUSHROOM TRIBE' on a sash and holding a small glowing jar labeled 'EVIDENCE'. He is surrounded by giant glowing mushrooms, oversized pink and yellow flowers, and bioluminescent vines in a surreal psychedelic forest under a rainbow sky.
